foods: Irani Chai with Osmania Biscuits at Nimrah Cafe

famous_foods_details.name: Hyderabadi Dum Biryani
famous_foods_details.description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with spiced marinated meat, saffron, and slow-cooked in sealed handi.
famous_foods_details.famous_spot: Hotel Shadab (Old City) / Cafe Bahar / Bawarchi

famous_foods_details.name: Irani Chai & Osmania Biscuits
famous_foods_details.description: Creamy, slow-brewed spiced tea served with warm, melt-in-mouth salty-sweet Osmania biscuits.

famous_foods_details.name: Hyderabadi Haleem
famous_foods_details.description: Rich stew of lentils, meat, broken wheat and aromatic spices pounded into velvety texture.

famous_foods_details.name: Double Ka Meetha
famous_foods_details.description: Crisp fried bread slices soaked in saffron rabri, cardamom syrup and topped with pistachios.

attractions.name: Charminar & Mecca Masjid
attractions.description: 16th-century grand monument with four majestic minarets rising over the historic Old City.
attractions.best_time: Early Morning or Lit Up at Evening

attractions.name: Golconda Fort
attractions.description: Impregnable hilltop fortress celebrated for its acoustic engineering, diamond vaults, and sunset panoramas.
attractions.best_time: Late Afternoon to Sound & Light Show

attractions.name: Hussain Sagar Lake & Buddha Statue
attractions.description: Heart-shaped lake featuring the world's tallest monolithic Buddha statue reached by speedboats.

attractions.name: Salar Jung Museum
attractions.description: One of the three National Museums of India housing the musical clock and marble Veiled Rebecca.

attractions.name: Qutb Shahi Tombs
attractions.description: Domed mausoleums set in landscaped heritage gardens built by the rulers of the Qutb Shahi dynasty.

attractions.name: Laad Bazaar
attractions.description: Centuries-old market bustling with shimmering bangles, Hyderabadi natural pearls, and wedding trousseau.

places_around.name: Ramoji Film City
places_around.desc: World's largest integrated film studio theme park

places_around.name: Ananthagiri Hills & Vikarabad
places_around.desc: Serene forest trails, coffee woods and trekking cliffs

places_around.name: Nagarjuna Sagar Dam
places_around.desc: Massive masonry dam with ancient Buddhist island museum

day_1.title: Old City Nizami Heritage & Charminar
day_1.morning: Climb upper galleries of Charminar; visit Mecca Masjid and explore Chowmahalla Palace.
day_1.afternoon: Dum Biryani lunch at Hotel Shadab; shop for pearls and bangles at bustling Laad Bazaar.
day_1.evening: Irani chai with Osmania biscuits beside Charminar as illuminated night lamps turn on.

day_2.title: Mighty Fortresses & Royal Tombs
day_2.morning: Visit majestic Qutb Shahi Tombs in serene heritage gardens.
day_2.afternoon: Scale the ramparts of Golconda Fort; test the acoustics of the clapping portico.
day_2.evening: Dramatic Golconda Sound & Light Show narration; traditional dinner in Banjara Hills.

day_3.title: World-Class Museum & Lake Promenade
day_3.morning: Admire the musical clock and Veiled Rebecca at Salar Jung Museum.
day_3.afternoon: Biryani lunch at Paradise; visit Birla Mandir carved entirely from white Rajasthani marble.
day_3.evening: Sunset boat ride on Hussain Sagar Lake to Buddha Statue; evening breeze along Necklace Road.

destinations.name: Goa
destinations.tagline: Golden Beaches, Water Sports, Portuguese Heritage and Vibrant Sunsets

transport.local: Self-drive scooters, tourist cabs, open jeeps and ferries

famous_foods_details.name: Goan Fish Curry Thali
famous_foods_details.description: Steaming rice served with coconut-kokum Kingfish curry, fried rava fish, kismoor, and sol kadhi.

famous_foods_details.name: Prawn Balchão
famous_foods_details.description: Spicy, tangy Goan-Portuguese shrimp pickle relish cooked in vinegar, red chilies, and toddy.

famous_foods_details.name: Traditional Bebinca
famous_foods_details.description: Multi-layered Indo-Portuguese pudding baked with coconut milk, egg yolks, sugar, and nutmeg.

famous_foods_details.name: Goan Poi & Chorizo Pao
famous_foods_details.description: Crusty wheat pocket bread stuffed with smoked, spiced Goan pork sausages.

attractions.name: Baga & Calangute Beach
attractions.description: Vibrant coastline famous for parasailing, jet-skiing, dolphin boat trips, and beach clubs.

attractions.name: Aguada Fort & Lighthouse
attractions.description: Portuguese fortress overlooking the confluence of the Mandovi River and Arabian Sea.

attractions.name: Dudhsagar Waterfalls
attractions.description: Spectacular 310m high waterfall resembling a 'sea of milk' amidst dense Western Ghats jungle.

attractions.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
attractions.description: Historic Old Goa basilica enshrining the sacred mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier.

attractions.name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter
attractions.description: Brightly colored Portuguese villas, vintage tiled nameplates, and European cafes in Panaji.

attractions.name: Palolem & Agonda Beach
attractions.description: Crescent-shaped peaceful beach lined with leaning coconut palms and quiet wooden cottages.

places_around.name: Gokarna (Karnataka)
places_around.desc: Untouched temple town with pristine Om and Kudle beaches

places_around.name: Netravali Wildlife Sanctuary
places_around.desc: Hidden forest springs, butterfly parks and jungle trekking

places_around.name: Chorla Ghat
places_around.desc: Misty mountain pass along the Goa-Karnataka border

day_1.title: North Goa Beaches & Coastal Fort
day_1.morning: Arrive and check in; morning scenic walk along Candolim and Calangute beach.
day_1.afternoon: Water sports at Baga Beach (parasailing, jet-ski, banana ride) and seafood lunch.
day_1.evening: Climb Fort Aguada for golden hour sea views; dinner at a lively beachfront shack with live music.

day_2.title: Colonial Heritage & Latin Quarter Walk
day_2.morning: Tour Old Goa's Basilica of Bom Jesus and Sé Cathedral.
day_2.afternoon: Stroll through the pastel-hued streets of Fontainhas Latin Quarter in Panaji; traditional Goan lunch.
day_2.evening: Sunset Mandovi River Cruise with folk dance performances; vibrant casino or beach cafe night.

day_3.title: Scuba Diving & Bohemian Cliffs
day_3.morning: Adventure excursion: Scuba diving or snorkeling near Grand Island with dolphin spotting.
day_3.afternoon: Chillout at Vagator Beach; hike up to Chapora Fort (Dil Chahta Hai viewpoint).
day_3.evening: Sunset at Curlies / Anjuna beach shack with bonfire, reggae music, and cocktails.

destinations.name: Bengaluru
destinations.tagline: The Garden City, Silicon Valley, and Craft Beer Capital of India

transport.local: Namma Metro, BMTC Vayu Vajra buses, auto-rickshaws and cabs

foods: Benne Masala Dosa at Vidyarthi Bhavan

famous_foods_details.name: Crispy Benne Masala Dosa
famous_foods_details.description: Golden-brown butter dosa stuffed with spiced potato mash, served with coconut chutney and sambar.

famous_foods_details.name: South Indian Filter Coffee
famous_foods_details.description: Frothy, strong chicory-infused coffee brewed in brass filters and served in traditional dabarah.

famous_foods_details.name: Bangalore Craft Beers
famous_foods_details.description: Freshly brewed craft IPAs, wheat ales, and mango ciders in expansive open-air microbreweries.

attractions.name: Bangalore Palace
attractions.description: 19th-century royal palace modelled after Windsor Castle with fortified towers and woodcarvings.

attractions.name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
attractions.description: 240-acre botanical haven founded by Hyder Ali, featuring centuries-old trees and a famous Glass House.

attractions.name: Cubbon Park & Vidhana Soudha
attractions.description: Expansive green sanctuary in city center adjacent to the monumental Vidhana Soudha state legislature.

attractions.name: Bannerghatta National Park
attractions.description: Protected reserve offering closed-vehicle wildlife safaris and a sprawling butterfly conservatory.

places_around.name: Nandi Hills
places_around.desc: Misty hilltop fortress famous for breathtaking sunrise above clouds

places_around.name: Mysore (Mysuru)
places_around.desc: City of royal palaces, Chamundi Hills and sandalwood art

places_around.name: Shivagange
places_around.desc: Sacred mountain peak shaped like a Shiva lingam with hill treks

day_1.title: Historical Palaces & Botanical Marvels
day_1.morning: Morning stroll in Lalbagh Botanical Garden; explore the iconic Glass House.
day_1.afternoon: Traditional Karnataka thali lunch; visit Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace and KR Market.
day_1.evening: Explore Bangalore Palace with audio guide; evening coffee at Church Street bookstores.

day_2.title: Green Heart & Silicon Pulse
day_2.morning: Jog or cycle through Cubbon Park, followed by breakfast at MTR or Vidyarthi Bhavan.
day_2.afternoon: Visit Visvesvaraya Industrial & Technological Museum and Karnataka Chitrakala Parishath.
day_2.evening: Sunset at Vidhana Soudha exterior; dinner and craft beverages in Indiranagar/Koramangala.

day_3.title: Spiritual Landmarks & Artisan Shopping
day_3.morning: Darshan and serene architecture at ISKCON Temple Bangalore in Rajajinagar.
day_3.afternoon: Explore National Gallery of Modern Art (NGMA) and cafe lunch.
day_3.evening: Shopping at Commercial Street; try authentic street bites at VV Puram Food Street.

day_4.title: Wildlife Safari or Outskirts Excursion
day_4.morning: Day trip to Bannerghatta National Park for the Lion & Tiger Safari.
day_4.afternoon: Butterfly Park walkthrough and picnic lunch near Bannerghatta.
day_4.evening: Return to MG Road; souvenir shopping and farewell dinner.

destinations.name: Jaipur

transport.local: Jaipur Metro, auto-rickshaws, e-rickshaws, app cabs

famous_foods_details.name: Dal Baati Churma
famous_foods_details.description: Baked hard wheat rolls (baati) soaked in pure ghee, served with spicy five-lentil dal and sweet powdered churma.

famous_foods_details.name: Pyaaz Kachori
famous_foods_details.description: Flaky, deep-fried pastry puff generously packed with caramelized spicy onion mixture and tamarind chutney.

famous_foods_details.name: Kulhad Lassi
famous_foods_details.description: Thick, creamy yogurt lassi served chilled in earthen clay pots and crowned with rich clotted cream (malai).

attractions.name: Amer Fort & Sheesh Mahal
attractions.description: Magnificent red sandstone citadel featuring the legendary hall of thousands of tiny imported mirrors.

attractions.name: Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds)
attractions.description: Iconic pink sandstone honeycomb screen with 953 ornate latticed windows designed for royal women.

attractions.name: City Palace & Jantar Mantar
attractions.description: Grand courtyards, armory museum, and UNESCO stone astronomical instruments with world's largest sundial.

attractions.name: Nahargarh Fort Sunset Viewpoint
attractions.description: Edge of the Aravalli hills overlooking the illuminated sprawl of Jaipur from Padao open-air cafe.

places_around.name: Pushkar
places_around.desc: Sacred holy lake, only Brahma temple and desert camel fair

places_around.name: Abhaneri (Chand Baori)
places_around.desc: Incredible 8th-century stepwell with 3,500 symmetrical geometric steps

places_around.name: Ranthambore National Park
places_around.desc: Premier Royal Bengal tiger reserve around ancient fortress ruins

day_1.title: Grand Forts & Hilltop Sunsets
day_1.morning: Morning excursion to Amer Fort; marvel at mirror mosaics in Sheesh Mahal.
day_1.afternoon: Visit Jaigarh Fort (world's largest cannon on wheels); authentic Rajasthani lunch.
day_1.evening: Watch the sunset overlooking the Pink City from Nahargarh Fort's Padao Cafe.

day_2.title: City Center Palaces & Old Town Bazaars
day_2.morning: Photo stop at Hawa Mahal; tour City Palace royal courtyards and Chandra Mahal.
day_2.afternoon: Explore stone astrological instruments at Jantar Mantar; stop at Lassiwala for curd lassi.
day_2.evening: Shop for block-print textiles, blue pottery, and jootis in Bapu Bazaar and Johari Bazaar.

foods: Warm Apple Pie at Old Manali Cafes

famous_foods_details.famous_spot: Local dhabas in Old Manali & Mall Road

famous_foods_details.name: Fresh Himalayan River Trout

famous_foods_details.name: Steamed Momos & Thukpa

famous_foods_details.famous_spot: Tibet Kitchen / Chopsticks on Mall Road

attractions.name: Atal Tunnel & Sissu (Lahaul)

attractions.name: Hadimba Temple

attractions.name: Old Manali Village & Cafes

places_around.name: Kasol & Parvati Valley

day_1.title: Pine Woods, Temples & Old Manali Vibe
day_1.morning: Visit 16th-century wooden Hadimba Temple surrounded by deodar forest.
day_1.afternoon: Walk across to Old Manali village; lunch at riverside cafes with trout or pizza.
day_1.evening: Soak your feet in Vashisht natural hot springs; evening stroll on Mall Road.

day_2.title: Solang Valley High Adrenaline Adventure
day_2.morning: Solang Valley thrill: Paragliding, ropeway cable car, and ATV quad bike rides.
day_2.afternoon: Drive through engineering marvel Atal Tunnel into snowy Sissu valley in Lahaul.
day_2.evening: Return for warm Siddu dinner with bonfire and acoustic guitar music.

destinations.name: Paris

famous_foods_details.name: French Macarons

day_1.title: Iconic Eiffel & Seine River Cruise
day_1.morning: Climb or elevator ascent of the Eiffel Tower; photograph from Trocadéro.
day_1.afternoon: Bistro lunch with quiche or croque monsieur; stroll down Champs-Élysées to Arc de Triomphe.
day_1.evening: Romantic sunset Bateaux Mouches river cruise gliding past Notre-Dame.

day_2.title: Masterpieces of the Louvre & Montmartre
day_2.morning: Tour the Louvre Museum to see the Mona Lisa and Winged Victory.
day_2.afternoon: Walk through Tuileries Garden and sample macarons at Ladurée.
day_2.evening: Funicular up to Montmartre; portrait drawing at Place du Tertre and French dinner.
